page.overview:
Who is Adolf Hitler?

Klara Pölzl (mother) Eva Braun (wife)}} [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adolf_Hitler Adolf Hitler], commonly referred to as Der Führer (meaning "leader" or "guide" in German) was the Austrian born dictator of Germany during the mid-twentieth century. He was leader of the National Socialist German Workers' Party (NSDAP), commonly abbreviated to the "Nazis" in slang, who rose to power on a platform combining racialism, ultranationalism, and righting what he perceived to be the wrongs done to Germany and Austria in the wakes of WW1. He is commonly seen as one of the greatest mass murderers in modern history, along with his Communist contemporaries Joseph Stalin and Mao Zedong, who were also responsible for the deaths of tens of millions. Along with Stalin, he helped start WW2 in Europe. He was also famous for his intense hatred of Jews, Romanies and Slavic peoples.

He is known for being one of the main antagonistic forces behind the Second World War exterminating and torturing millions of people invading and occupying other countries as well as being the founder Leader and Supreme Commander of the Nazi Party. His National Socialist Party existed from 1920 -1945 with many villains of the James Bond series being ex-National Socialists trying to continue his legacy.

Adolf Hitler died at 30 April 1945. The Red Army had entered Berlin, and were fighting to capture it, street by street. Hitler and his entourage were hidden in a bunker in the city, but as the invasion continued Hitler feared capture by the USSR, so he and his wife Eva Braun, and some of the other committed suicide by a self-inflected gunshot wound. Hitler's body was immolated outside the bunker, leading his body to be barely identifiable and spawning theories that he had fled to South America.

Interestingly, the weapon Hitler used to take his own life was none other than a customized golden Walther PPK, the same gun famously used by James Bond.
